settings.title: Prep Your Skin
settings.text: Start with a clean face. Gently cleanse your under-eye area to remove makeup, oil, or dirt for the best results.

settings.title: Dampen Skin
settings.text: Apply a water-based serum, conductive gel, or simply dampen the skin with water to improve microcurrent conductivity.

settings.question: How long does it take to see results?
settings.answer: Most users notice results in 2 weeks, with full transformation in 6-8 weeks.

settings.question: Does it work for all skin types?
settings.answer: Yes! It's safe for all skin tones and types, including sensitive skin.

settings.question: Does the device hurt to use?
settings.answer: No! It's a non-invasive, painless treatment. The EMS mode may give a slight tingling sensation, which means it's working.

settings.question: How long does the device take to charge?
settings.answer:
The device takes around 3 hours to charge fully, and lasts about 1 hour on a full charge.
Please note: each mode turns off automatically after 5 minutes to conserve battery.

settings.question: Can I use this with my other skincare products?
settings.answer: Yes! Using our device alongside your other skincare products helps enhance absorption and improve their effectiveness.

settings.question: Will the red light therapy damage my eyes?
settings.answer: No. The 630nm red LED light is safe, but you can close your eyes while wearing it for extra comfort.

settings.question: Can this device be used by both women and men?
settings.answer: Yes, this product is great for both women and men.
